modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Sunday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: Mitchell has missed OKC's previous two contests due to a sprained left ankle, and he's now in jeopardy of sitting out a third straight. If Mitchell remains sidelined, Jared McCain will continue to start for the 8-5 Thunder.

injury.shortComment: Nembhard is questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to left hip soreness.
injury.detail: Losing Nembhard would be a huge blow for the Pacers, as he's been the primary playmaker in the absence of Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) and has dished out at least six assists in his last four games. If he's forced to sit Sunday's contest, Quenton Jackson and two-way guard Braden Smith would be in line to see bigger roles in a depleted backcourt.

injury.shortComment: Sarr (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Sarr is under the weather and could miss the front end of this back-to-back set. The big man's absence would open up additional minutes for guys like Deandre Ayton, Anthony Gill and Will Riley.

injury.shortComment: Nesmith (hand) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Nesmith suffered a left hand sprain in the final seconds of Friday's win over the Knicks and could be held out of Sunday's road game. If the veteran swingman is unable to suit up, Jarace Walker, Quenton Jackson and Jalen Slawson would be candidates to see an uptick in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Johnson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rockets due to lower-back soreness.
injury.detail: Johnson has logged at least 27 minutes in each of Washington's last five games, but a back injury could prevent him from facing Houston on Sunday. If he and Bub Carrington (chest) are both ruled out, Will Riley could play meaningful minutes against the Rockets.

injury.shortComment: Murray (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.
injury.detail: Murray didn't participate in Saturday's shootaround, so the questionable tag isn't a surprise. De'Andre Hunter and Dylan Cardwell could play a bigger role if Murray isn't available, especially since Precious Achiuwa (ankle) is also uncertain to suit up Sunday.

injury.shortComment: Sexton (head) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
injury.detail: Sexton was a full participant in Saturday's practice, and while the questionable tag exercises some caution, he's trending in the right direction and could be available Sunday. The veteran has been putting up solid numbers of late, scoring in double digits in all but one of his last five appearances and averaging 11.0 points, 1.6 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game in that span.

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.
injury.detail: Achiuwa missed Friday's 120-107 loss to Portland due to left ankle soreness, and that same ailment will keep him questionable for Sunday's home tilt against OKC. Keegan Murray got the start in place of Achiuwa, which would likely be the case again if the latter is sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Gafford (face) won't return to Saturday's game against the Cavaliers, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
injury.detail: Gafford took a shot by Thomas Bryant and exited the game after making two free throws earlier, but the center won't return. This means Morez Johnson and Santi Aldama should see more time in the frontcourt. Gafford ends the contest with 10 points (4-5 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three rebounds and an assist across 17 minutes. His next chance to play will come Sunday against the Celtics on the second leg of a back-to-back set.

injury.shortComment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Smart, who was ejected from Wednesday's game for punching Charles Bassey, will begin serving his suspension Friday night against the Jazz, meaning he'll be eligible to return Wednesday versus Indiana. Bruce Thornton and Reed Sheppard should be in line for more minutes while Smart serves his three-game ban.

injury.shortComment: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: McConnell missed the Pacers' first nine games of the season due to hamstring problems, and although he still seems to be working through the injury, he's been able to play in each of Indiana's last four contests. The fact that he's been listed as probable is a positive sign that he'll suit up for a fifth straight game Sunday.

injury.shortComment: Carrington (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Carrington exited Thursday's loss to Detroit with a chest contusion and is now in jeopardy of missing his first game of the season. If the third-year guard is ruled out, Tre Mann and Will Riley could see increased burn, especially if Tre Johnson (back) is also downgraded from questionable to out.

injury.shortComment: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Christie was doubtful to play due to a left ankle sprain, and he will indeed be forced to sit out his second contest of the 2026-27 campaign. Expect Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher to see a boost in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Thiero (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Suns.
injury.detail: Thiero missed the first nine games of the season due to a knee injury, and he's now dealing with a sprained left ankle. If he's unable to suit up, Ziaire Williams and Sandro Mamukelashvili will likely soak up any vacated minutes.
